caseNameFull: Morrow v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division
judges: Application, Execution, Grant, Sou, Stay, Stevens, Ter

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Sou-ter, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
